title: Frontier
description: An endless procedural world for many players: chunk streaming, generated forests and camps, NPCs with branching dialogue, gold and per-player state. Plays solo, or as an MMO with `vertex serve`.

parts.d: M-3 -2 H-1 V0 H-3 Z M1 -2 H3 V0 H1 Z

entities.text: EXPLORE   COLLECT GOLD   E TO TALK

hello.speaker: {npc.data.name}
hello.text: Well met, traveller. The frontier goes on forever, they say. You carry {actor ? actor.data.gold : 0} gold.

lore.speaker: {npc.data.name}
lore.text: Forests, stones, and camps like this one, each lit by a fire. Every camp keeps a story. Collect gold and come back.

bought.speaker: {npc.data.name}
bought.text: A fine lantern. May it keep the dark away.

rich.speaker: {npc.data.name}
rich.text: Twenty gold! You are the richest soul on the frontier. Keep it; tales are worth more to me.

do: let cx = event.cx; let cy = event.cy; let s = event.size

repeat (5 + floor(hash(cx, cy, 1) * 9)) { let px = event.x + hash(cx, cy, 10 + i) * s; let py = event.y + hash(cx, cy, 40 + i) * s; if (noise(px / 180, py / 180, 3) > 0.42 && abs(px - 160) + abs(py - 160) > 90) spawn('tree', {x: px, y: py, tags: ['solid'], body: {static: true, collider: 'circle'}, scale: 0.8 + hash(cx, cy, 70 + i) * 0.6}) }

repeat (floor(hash(cx, cy, 2) * 3)) { let rx = event.x + hash(cx, cy, 100 + i) * s; let ry = event.y + hash(cx, cy, 130 + i) * s; if (abs(rx - 160) + abs(ry - 160) > 90) spawn('rock', {x: rx, y: ry, tags: ['solid'], body: {static: true}}) }
repeat (2 + floor(hash(cx, cy, 3) * 4)) spawn('coin', {x: event.x + hash(cx, cy, 200 + i) * s, y: event.y + hash(cx, cy, 230 + i) * s, tags: ['coin'], body: {sensor: true}, vr: 2})

if (hash(cx, cy, 4) < 0.35 || (cx == 0 && cy == 0)) { let fx = event.x + s / 2 + 40; let fy = event.y + s / 2; spawn('fire', {x: fx, y: fy, emitter: {shape: 'spark', rate: 8, life: [0.4, 0.9], speed: [10, 30], angle: [-2.4, -0.7]}}); spawn('npc', {x: fx - 26, y: fy, tags: ['npc', 'solid'], body: {static: true, collider: 'circle'}, interact: {prompt: 'Talk', dialogue: 'wanderer', radius: 40}, data: {name: hash(cx, cy, 5) < 0.5 ? 'Ilka' : 'Osric'}}) }
let l = sqrt(mx * mx + my * my); if (l > 1) { mx = mx / l; my = my / l }

rules.do: despawn(b); a.data.gold += 1; sound('coin'); spawn(null, {x: b.x, y: b.y, emitter: {shape: 'spark', burst: 8, rate: 0, life: [0.2, 0.4], speed: [30, 80]}, data: {ttl: 0.5}})

self.data.hud = (self.data.title ? self.data.name + ' ' + self.data.title + '  ' : '') + 'GOLD ' + str(self.data.gold) + (self.data.lantern ? '  LANTERN' : '') + '  ' + str(floor(self.x / 32)) + ',' + str(floor(self.y / 32))
let p = first('player'); state.hud = p ? p.data.hud : ''
